title: Weighted k-NN evaluation of frozen features
prompt: Weighted cosine k-NN classification for disjoint train/query features. Labels are contiguous nonnegative class IDs. Clamp k to gallery size; weights are exp((similarity-row_max)/temperature). Stable sorting breaks neighbor ties by gallery order and class ties by class ID. Return class scores and predictions.
